_comment: One cute animated .glb per species known from the Ateneo Loyola Heights campus. Species list: iNaturalist species_counts sweep of the campus box (fetched 2026-09-03T16:44:34.730Z) merged with the curated guide list in src/data.ts. The AIS inventory (due 2026-09-09) supersedes this list when it lands. palette_source 'known' = colors written from the species' real appearance; 'derived' = deterministic pick from tuned pools, not observed data. display_scale_m is a suggested real-world height hint for AR, not a measurement.
